blocks.text: back to Rasulullaah ﷺ crying out of happiness as I had been crying out of sorrow earlier. I said, 'Hear the good news. Allaah has accepted your du'aa and has guided the mother of Abu Hurayra to Islaam.' I then added, 'O Rasulullaah ﷺ! Pray to Allaah to make my mother and I beloved to every Mu'min male and female.' Rasulullaah ﷺ made du'aa saying, 'O Allaah! Make this little servant of Yours and his mother beloved to every Mu'min male and female.' Therefore whenever any male or female Muslim hears my name, they take a liking to me."[^1]
Hadhrat Ummu Sulaym (RA) Invites Hadhrat Abu Talha to Islaam when he Proposes to Her and he Accepts Islaam

blocks.arabic_text: اَشْهَدُ اَنْ لَّا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَاَشْهَدُ اَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَّسُوْلُ اللّٰهِ
blocks.text: Hadhrat Anas (RA) narrates that before he accepted Islaam, Hadhrat Abu Talha (RA) proposed for Hadhrat Ummu Sulaym (RA). She said to him, "O Abu Talha! Do you not know that the god you worship is a tree growing from the ground?" He replied, "I do indeed." She then said, "Do you not feel ashamed to worship a tree? If you accept Islaam, I require no other dowry from you." Hadhrat Abu Talha (RA) said that he would ponder over the matter and left. He later came back and said: "I testify that there is none worthy of worship but Allaah and that Muhammad ﷺ is Allaah's Rasul." Hadhrat Ummu Sulaym (RA) then said (to her son), "O Anas! Get Abu Talha married." Hadhrat Anas (RA) then conducted the Nikaah.[^2]
The Da'wah that The Sahabah (RA) Gave to Various Tribes and Arabs
The Da'wah Hadhrat Dimaam bin Tha'laba Gave to the Banu Sa'd bin Bakr Tribe

Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) narrates that the Banu Sa'd bin Bakr tribe sent Hadhrat Dimaam bin Tha'laba (RA) as their representative to Rasulullaah ﷺ. When he arrived (in Madinah), he seated his camel at he door of the Masjid and tied it up. He then entered the Masjid where Rasulullaah ﷺ was sitting with the Sahabah (RA). Hadhrat Dimaam (RA) was a large, hairy and heavily built man. He went forward and stood before Rasulullaah ﷺ and the Sahabah (RA). He then asked, "Which of you is the descendant of Abdul Muttalib?" Rasulullaah ﷺ replied, "I am the descendant of Abdul Muttalib." "Are you Muhammad?" Hadhrat Dimaam (RA) clarified. "Yes," confirmed Rasulullaah ﷺ.
